channel.title: Carlos S. Nah, Jr: Writing
channel.description: Essays and notes on software, teaching, and building a life on your own terms.

item.title: Happy International Boyfriend Day, I Guess
item.description: The day passed with barely any buzz. What our reactions to days like this reveal about public validation, double standards, and accountability in modern relationships.

item.title: The Choices of Our Subconscious
item.description: A quiet taxi ride beside two grieving strangers, and a reflection on the small, repeated choices that slowly become who we are.

item.title: Engineering in the Agentic Era
item.description: The real question is no longer whether AI will replace developers. It is how AI reshapes the way we work, and where our actual value as engineers lies.

item.title: The Dream They Promised Us
item.description: We were handed one script: study hard, earn the degree, get the job, and the life you imagined will follow. Reality told a very different story.
